claims.statement: For a phrase detector P and sentence s containing phrase p, the negated sentence containing 'not' + p also matches.
dependencies: Candidate canary phrase detector definitions in atlas/archive/pfp/003_pfp_host_admitted_failure_detectors/code/canaries.py.
Monotonicity of substring containment under string embedding and sentence negation.
claims.limits: Confirms that phrase matching depends solely on substring containment and does not distinguish assertions from negations, quotations, or questions.

claims.statement: The harvest has 112 rows: 102 scripted author responses and 10 from qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct, labelled by a prompt-specific rule set with no independent checker.
dependencies: Author-scripted hallucination and grounded text in probe specifications in eis/infrastructure/mssn_domains.py.
Prompt-specific regular expression rule sets in eis/infrastructure/mssn_classifier.py without independent review.
claims.limits: Documents the provenance, row composition, and labelling procedure of the historical harvest; does not measure model error rates or general detector accuracy.
